name: Nox
source:
Nox was once a noble god that aided hunters, as well as others who became lost in his forests. He was known to be serious, but sincere.

However, following the end of age of the gods, he was captured and tortured by a group of selfish humans who yearned for power. Years of hatred turned him into a demon. After Soren aided Caspian in escaping, Nox possessed him with the intent of seeking revenge.

[From in-game profile]
